title: Compute initial slope for general case (m_A ≠ m_B)
action: Implement the general formula for the initial slope dT_g/dc at c=0 derived from the Stochastic Agglomeration Theory. Use the provided parameters m_A, m_B (coordination numbers) and T_g0, T_g1 (pure-component glass transition temperatures) for the general case where m_A ≠ m_B. Compute the slope value and write it to the output file.
description: Initial slope dT_g/dc at zero modifier concentration for the general case (m_A ≠ m_B).

title: Compute initial slope for equal-valence case (m_A = m_B)
action: Implement the limit of the slope formula for the equal-valence case where m_A = m_B. Using the provided parameters T_g0, T_g1 for case 2, evaluate the slope dT_g/dc at c=0 and write the numeric result to the output file.
description: Initial slope dT_g/dc at zero modifier concentration for the equal-valence case (m_A = m_B).
